newsitem.title: CANADA: Provigo sees C$15 mln gain on C Corp sale.
newsitem.headline: Provigo sees C$15 mln gain on C Corp sale.

text.p: Provigo Inc said on Monday that it expects a C$15 million unusual gain on the sale of its C Corp unit to Alimentation Couche-Tard Inc for C$85 million.
The transaction is expected to close in mid-May. Provigo said it has also arranged a long-term contract to continue supplying C Corp's Provi-Soir stores in Quebec.
Provigo said it will apply the proceeds of the sale to finance the repurchase of its preferred shares, thereby reducing the cost of capital and further strengthening its balance sheet.
In a statement, Pierre Mignault, president and chief executive officer of Provigo, said the decision to sell C Corp is in keeping with the company's business plan.
"We want to focus all our efforts on the development of our retail network -- Provigo and LOED supermarkets, and Maxi and Maxi & Co discount stores," he said.
C Corp regroups 254 Provi-Soir convenience stores in Quebec and about 50 stores in Ontario and Alberta under the Winks and Red Rooster banners.
